name: E4_2_mbert_garg2026_sentiment
description: Reproduction of the Hinglish sentiment recipe of Garg et al. (arXiv:2601.05091, Jan 2026; NLPIR 2025): bert-base-multilingual-cased, [CLS] + dropout + linear head, AdamW lr 2e-5, batch 8, 3 epochs, weight decay 0.01, 500 warmup steps (= 0.228 of 2,196 steps on our 5,854 training texts), max length 128. Their extra preprocessing (lowercasing, stop-word removal, emoji words) is not reproduced; our normalization is used. Trained on our frozen sentiment splits. Pre-registered test.
